data.description: The Shrimp Slide is a low red slide shaped like a curled shrimp, reached by a short steel ladder. Its shape gives a toddler area a playful character piece that children recognise at once. At 3 ft high it suits the youngest group of children, who can climb the ladder and slide down without needing an adult to lift them. Themed slides like this work well in play schools, society toddler corners and resort kids' areas where looks matter as much as play. The colour is Play Red. Like our other slides, it has a 3-year warranty on galvanised and roto-moulded parts. Share a photo of your toddler area and we will suggest where it fits.

items.pText: The Shrimp Slide is a low red slide shaped like a curled shrimp, reached by a short steel ladder. Its shape gives a toddler area a playful character piece that children recognise at once. At 3 ft high it suits the youngest group of children, who can climb the ladder and slide down without needing an adult to lift them. Themed slides like this work well in play schools, society toddler corners and resort kids' areas where looks matter as much as play. The colour is Play Red. Like our other slides, it has a 3-year warranty on galvanised and roto-moulded parts. Share a photo of your toddler area and we will suggest where it fits.

The shrimp body is moulded and the ladder is galvanised steel, so it handles sun and rain. We fix it self-standing or grouted. Lay an impact-absorbing surface at the foot of the slide, and check the ladder fixings and slide surface for cracks during maintenance.
